label: canon-je24-n48-cont
_why: CONTINUATION OF THE 60-RUN PLAN (BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.76): runs 13–60 of canon-je24 (the canon canon4v-hai3 with research_events.industry_bar_months 24). The first session, 20260906_001032_canon-je24-n60, completed runs 1–11 (11 usable: 9 clean + 2 F99 stalls, runs 3 and 9) and lost run 12 at 1917 to a HARNESS RACE (BUGS_AND_FIXES 2026-09-07: the observer's log write threw 'Stream was not readable' while the batch heartbeat read run.log, and under ErrorActionPreference Stop the observer unwound with the game still running; runs 13–60 then died in seconds on the already-running guard). The four harness log writers now retry and never throw. This schedule supplies the 48 runs the plan still owes, unchanged in every other respect. THE GATE: after this session's run 19 (= the plan's run 30: 11 usable from the first session + 19 here) run `node tools/testbed/ledger/assess_gdp_gate.mjs --session 20260906_001032_canon-je24-n60,<this stamp> --setup canon-je24` — the tool pools the usable runs of both sessions; ≥ 0.95 → the schedule runs on; below → STOP file as run 20's folder appears, delete it, launch canon_je24_a22_n30.json.

_delta: vs the first session: nothing in the mod or the game; the harness log writers (run_observer / run_schedule / archive_autosaves / harvest_saves) retry a held-open log file instead of throwing — telemetry, saves and summaries are unaffected, so the two sessions are one arm.

_plan.gate: after run019 of THIS session completes (plan run 30): node tools/testbed/ledger/assess_gdp_gate.mjs --session 20260906_001032_canon-je24-n60,<this stamp> --setup canon-je24 (threshold 0.95, world GDP at 1935 ÷ vanilla n=16 median, mean over the pooled usable runs)

_plan.unsteered: if nobody is there at the gate the schedule simply completes 48 runs of canon-je24 (plan run 60)

_predictions: the first session's P1–P7 stand (canon_je24_n60.json); interim at n=10: mean 0.810×, two F99 stalls in ten (P5 allowed two in thirty), two CTDs in eleven both resumed
_comparison: the first session 20260906_001032_canon-je24-n60 (same arm); canon4v-hai3-n2 20260905_174831 (F106); vanilla n=16 20260821_131149 as the denominator.
_watch: every run, ~5 min after it starts: the batch heartbeat (marker, version, error window by parsed time, clock)
after run019 completes: the pooled GDP gate (see _plan); post the verdict
post-run: preflight -Session on BOTH sessions, one VERDICT.md per session, SESSION_VERDICTS rows, FINDINGS, the ledger over the pooled usable runs
_caveats: Two session folders, one arm: every reader must pool them (assess_gdp_gate takes --session a,b; the ledger scripts take one --session each and need the pooled list built by hand from lib_runs' rule).

The first session's run 12 is lost (no meta.json; L17 excludes it) and its runs 13–60 are empty folders that L17 also excludes; the session's own SCHEDULE DONE says 60/60 and is not evidence of anything.
A Steam update between runs splits the batch (2026-08-12); each heartbeat reads the version line.
A leftover tools/testbed/STOP kills the next launch's first run at 1836 — delete it before any relaunch.
